earlyBird.text: Book and confirm your company Christmas party before 30 October and everyone gets a Christmas cocktail on arrival, on us.

items.name: Avocado, prawn & pomegranate seed cocktail
items.desc: Shredded lettuce, cherry tomatoes, marie-rose sauce, lemon zest & buttered artisan bread.

items.name: Traditional roast turkey
items.desc: Pigs in blankets, peas & carrots, Brussels sprouts, parsnips, herb-roasted potatoes, stuffing & our rich gravy.

items.name: Seasonal smashed beef burger
items.desc: On traditional stuffing, topped with stilton & cranberry sauce in a warm brioche-style bun, with a pigs-in-blankets skewer & french fries.

items.name: Traditional fish & chips
items.desc: Battered cod & chips with tartare sauce, mushy peas & a lemon wedge.

items.name: Winter vegetable wellington
items.desc: Puff pastry filled with butternut squash, chickpeas, potato, carrots & walnuts, with herb-roasted potatoes, peas, carrots & our classic gravy.

items.name: Chocolate brownie
items.desc: With chocolate ice cream & salted caramel sauce. Vegan option available.

items.name: Cajun chicken strips with cool sour cream & hot honey dips
Tempura battered king prawns with a sweet chilli dip
Mini battered cod goujons with tartare sauce

drinks.name: Christmas Mimosa
drinks.desc: Prosecco, orange juice, amaretto & a splash of grenadine.

drinks.name: Snowball
drinks.desc: Advocaat & lemonade with a dash of lime cordial.

drinks.name: The Grinch
drinks.desc: Peach schnapps, Bacardi, blue curaçao & orange juice, topped with lemonade.

virgins.name: Christmas Mule
virgins.desc: Raspberry purée, ginger ale, lemonade & a splash of lime.

virgins.name: Virgin Mimosa
virgins.desc: Orange juice, soda & a splash of grenadine.

day.title: Christmas Day at the Moretown Belle
day.welcome: Choose a welcome cocktail or mocktail: Christmas Mimosa, Snowball or Christmas Mule.
day.extras: Bar open 11am to 6pm. Crackers on the tables, activity packs for the kids, pool tables and darts boards free to play, and the King's Christmas Day speech on the big screen.
